items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for MNF vs Dallas. Saquon Barkley questionable but expected to play.
items.implication: More targets to AJ Brown/Goedert; Saquon expected boosts PHI run game vs DAL.
items.opportunity: AJB routes/targets already elite; Goedert funnel.

items.text: Lamar Jackson downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs Bengals with high ankle sprain; third straight miss. Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; official downgrade Saturday.
items.implication: Ravens offense limited; Huntley start. Fade Lamar, consider Ravens pass-catchers carefully or Huntley stream in deep leagues.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf); McVay says will test pregame after limited power/explosion. Missed Friday practice.
items.why: Calf felt during Thursday practice; minor per reports but GTD.
items.implication: Monitor pregame; if OUT, heavy TE funnel and depth WRs.
items.opportunity: If OUT: elevated TE target share (prior 37% when Puka missed).

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad); limited practices Thu/Fri after missing prior weeks. Crucial DFS slate status.
items.why: Quad; improving but limited, GTD vs MIA.
items.implication: If active start per Berry; if OUT Braelon Allen RB1 upside in good matchup.
items.opportunity: Full role if active vs soft MIA; committee risk.

items.text: Mike Evans (Achilles) OUT vs Falcons per Shanahan; Deebo Samuel also OUT. SF WR corps decimated.
items.why: Coach confirm Achilles and other ailments; Deebo too.
items.implication: Massive Kittle funnel + CMC slot/WR temptation. Christian Kirk activated for debut.
items.opportunity: Kittle routes/targets spike; CMC more receiving.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs from exempt; expected to play Sunday at Detroit. Levitan notes facility access earlier, backups poor (Lloyd/Johnson low EPA).
items.why: Activated; expected to play after meetings/lifting allowed.
items.implication: Immediate role but rust/workload questions; Berry fades due to layoff.
items.conflict: Berry HATES Jacobs post-layoff; Levitan more neutral long-term.

items.text: If Puka Nacua can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell 5. Jordan Whittington 6. Davis Allen. With Adams also OUT.
items.why: Calf uncertainty + Adams long-term hamstring OUT; prior TE share spike when Puka missed.
items.implication: Higbee lead option; stash/stream Rams TEs and depth WRs. Berry notes same 37% TE share precedent.
items.opportunity: TE target share spike; routes/targets to Higbee/Parkinson.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring). 49ers DvP inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th most); recent RB catches/TDs high. Sweet full-workload setup for Bijan Robinson.
items.why: BRob hamstring OUT; SF soft vs RBs recently (White, Holani, Harvey, Love).
items.implication: Bijan bellcow + receiving upside vs soft DvP. Start with confidence.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts: scheme + entire SF WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT). Rarely buy RB-as-WR but tempted by CMC slot comments amid WR injuries + Kaelon Black.
items.why: WR injuries force funnel; CMC smiled at slot question.
items.implication: Kittle elite TE1 lock; CMC receiving upside boost even if rare.

items.text: LOVE A.J. Brown @ CHI: 97% routes, 33% target share in Wk6 (even with drops); buying the usage. Elite volume vs soft Bears.
items.why: Route/target share elite; Bears good for yardage. 10 Facts confirms.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; even better with DeVonta OUT.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR for big workloads in friendly matchups. Also Saquon/Breece if active.
items.why: Workloads + soft run Dvs (Warren/Irving carved up; Hubbard consistent). Saquon efficient + DAL soft; Breece if plays vs MIA.
items.implication: Start these RBs confidently (monitor Breece/Saquon statuses).

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK with Caleb: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/game, 6+ rec and 60+ yards in both games since Williams return.
Luther Burden elite 2.56 YPRR on 68.8% routes; Kmet IR may reduce 2/3-sets for more Burden juice. TreVeyon Henderson down to 21% snaps last 3 weeks (downgrade).
items.why: YPRR elite + potential route increase; Henderson snap collapse.
items.implication: Burden breakout candidate/roster; fade or bench Henderson.
items.opportunity: Burden routes/targets up; Henderson limited snaps/carries.

items.text: HATE Rome Odunze vs NE (Gonzalez shadow, outside targets), Josh Downs @ MIN (low TS/scoring), Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough D), Josh Jacobs @ DET (layoff questions).
items.conflict: Jacobs now activated/expected; Levitan notes poor backups support role.
